    activity = apis.splitwise.show_activity(
        access_token=splitwise_token,
        show_expenses=True,
        show_payments=False,
        page_index=page_index,
        page_limit=20,
        sort_by='-created_at'
    )

        break
    all_expenses.extend(activity)

        continue
    created = exp.get('created_at', '')
    if created.startswith(yesterday_str):
        # Check if user is in owed_by
        owed_by = exp.get('owed_by', [])
        for debtor in owed_by:
            if debtor.get('email') == user_email:
                relevant_expenses.append(exp)
                break
